name: Default
shortDescription: Caddy web server serving a static site from a persistent volume, configured through an editable Caddyfile for file serving, redirects or reverse proxying.

alerts.message: Caddy serves its welcome page until you replace the files in the caddy-site volume (/usr/share/caddy) or edit the Caddyfile. Keep the :80 site address: HTTPS is handled in front of the container.
